text:
Jordan P: CI shard 17/20 failing against hosted integration with repeated 'auth handshake timeout' errors on streaming/tool calls. Started ~09:10 UTC.
Micah L: ugh. any recent changes to token refresh or proxy configs?
Jordan P: there was a tiny config tweak in #3342 that adjusted the token rotate window from 30s -> 10s. suspicious.
Priya G: can you paste the failing log chunk?
Jordan P: here — frequent timeout when establishing websocket to hosted api:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03.214Z ERROR connection: auth handshake timeout after 15000ms
at HostedClient._connect (hosted_client.js:212)
at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93)
request id: job-98765 shard=17
headers: { 'x-request-id': 'job-98765', 'x-session': 'redacted' }
```
Sana R: that looks like a TLS/socket hang rather than a 401. Could be upstream rotate or rate-limit on auth endpoint.
Micah L: if #3342 changed rotate window, it might trigger mid-handshake refresh and close sockets. can we rerun the shard against the last known-good commit?
Jordan P: yes please — need a bisect. @ci-bot queue rerun for job-98765 shard 17 on commit before 0a1b2c3
ci-bot: ✅ rerun queued: job-98766 (shard 17) — will run on commit 0a1b2c2. Estimated 4m.
Priya G: while that's running, try dumping the auth-server logs for ~09:10-09:15 to see rotate events.
Jordan P: pulled logs, saw a rotation event at 09:11:58 for customer tokens. rotation service reported 503 briefly.
Sana R: 503 during rotate -> clients trying to refresh could hang. we should add a fallback: retry refresh once before tearing down websocket.
Micah L: agree. for quick triage, can someone bisect between 0a1b2c2 and current head to confirm correlation?
Sana R: I'll run git bisect locally and then request CI bisect if it reproduces.
Jordan P: thanks. local bisect repro'd: bad commit appears to be 0f9d4a7 which contains the rotate-window change.
Priya G: ok that's actionable. quick fix: revert the rotate-window change in integration branch or add a short jitter + retry on auth refresh. which do we want for short-term?
Micah L: revert in canary branch and ship a hotfix to CI config. then open a follow-up to do graceful retries.
Jordan P: filing hotfix PR now -> #3378. tagging for review: @Micah @Sana
Micah L: reviewing now :eyes:
ci-bot: job-98766 (shard 17) ✅ PASSED on commit 0a1b2c2
Sana R: good — that confirms it was the rotate-window change. thanks all. I'll follow up with a postmortem note and add a regression test for auth rotate edge cases.
Jordan P: thanks team :thumbsup:
Priya G: add a quick smoke check in integration pipeline to hit auth rotate endpoint during setup, that'll catch this earlier.
Jordan P: noted. PR #3378 ready for merge after Micah review.
Micah L: merged and deploying to CI config. monitoring.
Jordan P: closing the thread when CI verification completes.
